entries.text: It affects people's lives.
entries.translation: 它会影响人们的生活。

entries.text: Have you ever reported on a big weather event?
entries.translation: 你报道过大型天气事件吗？

entries.text: I had been waiting for that blizzard for years.
entries.translation: 我已经等那场暴风雪很多年了。

entries.text: When it came, I was ready.
entries.translation: 它来的时候，我已经准备好了。

entries.text: I have wanted to report on a big weather event my whole life.
entries.translation: 我一辈子都想报道一场大型天气事件。

entries.text: Did you report all weekend by yourself?
entries.translation: 你整个周末都是一个人报道的吗？

entries.text: Why am I here on a Saturday?
entries.translation: 我为什么周六还在这里？

entries.text: Where are your supplies?
entries.translation: 你的物资在哪里？

entries.text: This could be the blizzard of the century.
entries.translation: 这可能会是本世纪的大暴风雪。

entries.text: How else have you prepared?
entries.translation: 你还做了哪些准备？

entries.text: I had just bought the latest weather forecasting software.
entries.translation: 我刚买了最新的天气预测软件。

entries.text: This computer is a work tool.
entries.translation: 这台电脑是工作工具。

entries.text: It will give us the temperature, wind speed, wind direction and amount of snowfall in real time.
entries.translation: 它会实时提供温度、风速、风向和降雪量。

entries.text: We need a name for this blizzard.
entries.translation: 我们得给这场暴风雪起个名字。

entries.text: Every time a record was broken, we celebrated.
entries.translation: 每次有纪录被打破，我们都会庆祝。

entries.text: Snow has been falling for 30 hours straight.
entries.translation: 雪已经连续下了 30 个小时。

entries.text: By Saturday night, stores and restaurants had closed.
entries.translation: 到周六晚上，商店和餐馆都关门了。

entries.text: Did you bring enough food?
entries.translation: 你带够食物了吗？

entries.text: I thought I had brought enough food, but I ran out.
entries.translation: 我原以为带够了食物，但还是用完了。

entries.text: Maybe you ate it already.
entries.translation: 也许你已经吃掉它了。

entries.text: That must have been a great team-building exercise.
entries.translation: 那一定是一次很棒的团队建设活动。
